system.flavor: Cover a friend's dash across an open yard, keep the stones flying from a rooftop off someone picking a lock, or send a shot past a thrower's ear so a child gets clear. Get one person moving and keep the thrown things off them while they go.

body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. The target may move 1 unit and gains +1 Fortitude against ranged attacks until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Protect a second willing creature within 2 units of the first.

rider.title: Lock - Suppression
rider.html: While your Lock is visible, you may end it when its target attacks a protected creature before your next turn to reduce that attack's Damage by 1.
